# BillMint

> Simple time tracking and invoicing for freelancers and small teams.

BillMint is a web-based time tracking software with invoicing built in. Freelancers, consultants, and small teams use it to track billable hours, create professional invoices, and get paid faster.

## Key Features

### Time Tracking
Track time with a one-click timer from your dashboard, or manually log hours against any project. All tracked time can be automatically converted into invoice line items, making billing effortless.

### Professional Invoice Creation
Create beautiful, professional invoices with customizable templates. Upload your logo, adjust colors, and edit footer text to match your brand. Send invoices directly to clients via email.

### Client and Project Management
Organize your work by clients and projects. Store client contact information, billing details, and track which projects belong to which clients. Create projects to categorize time entries and invoices.

### Recurring Invoices
Set up invoices to automatically generate and send on a schedule. Choose from weekly, monthly, quarterly, or yearly frequencies. Perfect for retainer clients and subscription services.

### Multi-Currency Support
Work with clients around the world using support for major currencies including USD, EUR, GBP, and RON. Set a default currency in settings and override it per client or per invoice as needed.

### Billable Hours Conversion
Automatically convert tracked time entries into invoice line items. Your hourly rate is applied automatically, and you can review and adjust before sending.

### PDF Invoice Export
Export professional invoices as PDF files for offline storage or printing. PDFs include all invoice details, line items, and your custom branding.

### Time Reports and Analytics
Generate detailed time reports to understand how you spend your time. Filter by project, client, or date range. Track billable vs non-billable hours to optimize your productivity.

## Use Cases

BillMint is ideal for:

- **Freelance developers** tracking billable hours across client projects and generating invoices for completed work
- **Freelance designers** managing project time and invoicing clients for design services
- **Consultants** tracking time and billing for professional services and advisory work
- **Virtual assistants** logging hours for multiple clients and creating invoices for administrative support
- **Small agencies** managing team time tracking and client invoicing in one centralized platform
- **Accountants** tracking billable hours for client work and tax preparation services
- **Lawyers and legal professionals** tracking case time and billing clients for legal services
- **Any solo professional** who needs simple time tracking with invoicing built in

## How It Works

### 1. Track Time
Start a timer from your dashboard or manually log hours against a project. Categorize time as billable or non-billable. Add notes to describe what you worked on.

### 2. Create Invoice
Click "New Invoice", select a client, and add line items. Convert tracked time into line items automatically, or add custom line items manually. Customize the invoice template with your branding.

### 3. Get Paid
Send the invoice directly to your client via email. They receive a professional PDF invoice. Track invoice status (draft, sent, paid) and follow up with payment reminders.

## Technical Details

BillMint is a modern web application that works in any browser. No software download required. Your data is encrypted at rest and in transit using industry-standard security practices. Authentication is handled securely, and payment processing is PCI-DSS compliant through Stripe.

## Pricing

- **Free plan**: Unlimited time tracking, 1 user, basic reports. Perfect for getting started.
- **Pro plan**: $5/month - Unlimited invoices, clients, projects, PDF export, full reports, recurring invoices, multi-currency support. 14-day money-back guarantee.

## Comparison to Alternatives

BillMint is an alternative to Toggl, Harvest, and Clockify for freelancers who also need invoicing built-in. Unlike standalone time trackers, BillMint combines time tracking software with invoicing in one tool. You don't need to pay for separate apps or manually transfer data between systems.

While Toggl excels at pure time tracking and Harvest offers robust project management, BillMint focuses on the essential freelancer workflow: track time, create invoice, get paid. It's simpler and more affordable than enterprise tools, with pricing designed for solo professionals and small teams.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How do I create my first invoice?**
Navigate to the Dashboard, click "New Invoice", select a client, add your line items, and hit "Send". Your client will receive the invoice via email.

**How does time tracking work?**
Start a timer from the Dashboard or manually log hours against a project. Tracked time can be converted into invoice line items automatically.

**Can I customize my invoice template?**
Yes. Go to Settings > Invoice and you can upload your logo, adjust colors, and edit the footer text that appears on every invoice.

**How do I add a new client?**
Go to the Clients page from the sidebar and click "Add Client". Fill in their name, email, and billing details. You can also create a client directly when drafting a new invoice.

**Can I send recurring invoices?**
Yes. When creating an invoice, enable the "Recurring" option and set the frequency (weekly, monthly, quarterly, or yearly). BillMint will automatically generate and send invoices on schedule.

**What currencies are supported?**
BillMint currently supports major currencies including USD, EUR, GBP, and RON. You can set a default currency in Settings and override it per client or per invoice.
